worked_solution:
To find the $x$-intercepts of the hyperbola, we substitute $y=0$ into the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}7{x}^{2}-{y}^{2} & =7 \\ 7{x}^{2}-{0}^{2} & =7 \\ 7{x}^{2} & =7 \\ {x}^{2} & =1 \\ x & =\pm 1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $x$-intercepts are $(\pm 1,0).$
